title: CLAIMGATE: Cautious On-Device Checking of Spoken Legal and Clinical Claims
abstract: arXiv:2611.31569v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In law and medicine, a misstated rule can shape a decision before anyone has time to check it. Checking such claims in real time helps only if the checker keeps pace with conversation, keeps sensitive audio on the device, and stays silent rather than mislead. We present CLAIMGATE, an on- device assistant that listens to a conversation, detects checkable claims, retrieves the relevant official rule, and labels each claim as supported, contradicted or not covered, with a citation. CLAIMGATE is designed to fail towards silence: its 4-bit 7B- parameter language model may cite only retrieved rules, and the verdict is derived in code from the claim and rule the model quotes. We evaluate it on traffic stops and medical visits using real official rule text (5,742 Florida and Texas statute subsections; CDC, FDA and MedlinePlus guidance), real transcripts, live speech and author-written gold-labelled claims. On 141 held-out traffic-stop claims, CL

translated_title: CLAIMGATE：对口头法律与临床声明的谨慎设备端核查
translated_abstract: 在法律和医学领域，一条被错误陈述的规则可能在任何人来得及核查之前就已影响决策。只有当核查工具能够跟上对话节奏、将敏感音频保留在设备上，并在无法确定时保持沉默而非误导时，实时核查此类声明才真正有帮助。我们提出了CLAIMGATE，这是一种设备端助手，它监听对话、检测可核查的声明、检索相关的官方规则，并为每条声明标注“支持”、“反驳”或“未覆盖”，同时附上引用。CLAIMGATE的设计原则是“失败时趋于沉默”：其采用4比特量化的70亿参数语言模型只允许引用检索到的规则，且判定结果由代码根据模型所引用的声明和规则推导得出。我们使用真实的官方规则文本（5,742条佛罗里达州和德克萨斯州法规子条款；CDC、FDA和MedlinePlus指南）、真实转录文本、实时语音以及作者撰写并带有金标准标签的声明，在交通拦截和医疗就诊场景中对该系统进行评估。在141条留出的交通拦截声明上，CL……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: CLAIMGATE是一个运行在设备端的实时核查助手，能在法律和医疗对话中检测可核查的声明、检索官方规则并给出带引用的判定，且其设计确保在无法确定时保持沉默而非误导用户。
en_tdlr: CLAIMGATE is an on-device assistant that checks spoken legal and clinical claims in real time by retrieving official rules and issuing code-derived cited verdicts, designed to fail towards silence when uncertain to avoid misleading users.
